Scholarships to support your research journey
Adelaide University is committed to supporting graduate research students throughout their degree. In-candidature scholarships provide targeted financial assistance to help you progress your research, participate in conferences, undertake fieldwork or manage unforeseen challenges during your candidature. The range of scholarships and eligibility criteria may vary depending on your discipline and stage of study.
Scholarship rounds
Travel scholarships
Additional funding
Prestigious scholarships
Scholarship rounds
Graduate research scholarships at Adelaide University are offered through competitive rounds held throughout the year. These rounds provide opportunities for both domestic and international students to apply for funding aligned with their research goals and academic performance. Each round has specific eligibility criteria, deadlines and application requirements. View current and upcoming scholarship rounds.
Travel scholarships
Travel scholarships provide additional financial support to graduate research students undertaking research-related travel. These scholarships are designed to assist with expenses such as fieldwork, conference attendance or collaboration with external institutions.
Travel scholarships may be awarded as part of competitive rounds and may vary by faculty or discipline. Graduate research students are encouraged to review eligibility criteria and application timelines carefully.
If available, these scholarship opportunities are individually listed in the University's scholarship database.
Additional funding opportunities
In addition to major and travel scholarships, there are other opportunities available to graduate research students to top up their income or to supplement their operating costs. These opportunities can be funded by philanthropic sources, industry programs or research grants. These scholarships are individually listed in the University's scholarship database.
Most, but not all, of these opportunities are offered separately to the scholarship rounds and require a separate and specific application or Expression of Interest. You will find information about how to apply for individual scholarships attached to the funding opportunity in the University's scholarship database unless otherwise advertised by your College, School or Institute.
Prestigious scholarships
Prestigious scholarships offer graduate research students the opportunity to pursue advanced study at leading institutions around the world, including Adelaide University. These highly competitive awards support individuals with exceptional academic achievement, leadership potential and a commitment to creating positive impact.
Whether your goal is to contribute to global challenges, lead innovation in your field or shape a better future, these scholarships can help you take the next step.

Industry opportunities
Adelaide University is committed to preparing graduate research students for impactful careers by connecting academic learning with real-world experience. Through research internships and industry-engaged programs, you will have the opportunity to apply your expertise in professional settings, develop advanced skills and build valuable networks within your chosen field.
Our strong partnerships with industry, government and the wider community ensure that your research is relevant and meaningful, and that you are equipped to address challenges across sectors. Engaging with industry during your candidature will complement your academic studies and provide a competitive edge as you move into your future career.
Industry-engaged graduate research program
Engage with industry throughout your candidature and gain valuable insights into careers outside academia. Visit the Graduate researcher industry engagement webpage to find out more, or email us.
Research internships
Complete a three-month research internship. Solve real world problems, while gaining a significant employment advantage. Visit the Graduate researcher industry engagement webpage to find out more, or email augrs.industry@adelaide.edu.au.
First Nations scholarship opportunities
Adelaide University is committed to being a university of choice for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Peoples and supporting their development as Graduate Researchers. Adelaide University has a range of scholarship and funding opportunities specifically to support Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander students undertaking a research degree. Please refer to the dedicated webpage for more information.
